assessment_policy: Separate validity, concrete contribution, priority and fertility. Exact physical-interface refinement, costed maintenance comparison and verified two-update composition are contributions enabled by known lumpability and PTM tools.

branch_additions.title: Implementation-relative stochastic symmetry and costed corrective maintenance
branch_additions.hypothesis: A real correction mechanism may break the symmetry of its ideal task and thereby enlarge the sufficient stochastic boundary; maintaining an existing interpreter can outperform redundancy.
branch_additions.reactivation_trigger: A mathematically symmetric primitive is replaced by a physical noisy circuit, or redundant designs are compared without paying for their voter and its maintenance.
branch_additions.minimal_test: Three physical bits, hidden bank health, six-NAND majority, two update primitives; independent raw-event and quotient laws; compare six priced architectures against direct selector maintenance.
branch_additions.acceptance_gate: Exact projection identities, explicit equal-count counterexample, whole-interval service comparison and a physically affordable policy. Do not generalize beyond the grammar or fixed portfolio.
branch_additions.contribution: Physical16-state register reduces to12 classes while ideal majority would permit8; exact symmetry gap2gamma(1-gamma)(1-2gamma)^2;192 row and384 two-update checks; maintaining four gates dominates maintaining the voter of a triplicated design over the whole service-success interval in the fixed task.

branch_updates.evidence: A reduced stochastic boundary preserves arbitrary repeated words of the two declared updates, including hidden substrate noise. The physical circuit demands a distinguished-port refinement.
branch_updates.remaining_gate: One physically updated diagnostic must select operation or maintenance in a recurrent process with a hidden selector condition.
branch_updates.dead_end_trigger: A reduced current register law loses a persistent source of future failures or gains a free health observation.
branch_updates.minimal_test: Exactly two shared-component controller libraries, same plant and budget; construct update/decision witness and a smallest separating history.

branch_updates.evidence: The final voter is paid and fallible. Same-technology triplication loses; maintenance restores value, but cheaper direct selector maintenance is better in the fixture.
branch_updates.remaining_gate: Price the circuit that selects maintenance, not an exogenous reliable trigger; derive the joint recurrent resource/interface guarantee.
branch_updates.dead_end_trigger: Extra copies cannot change the last-port limitation or a purported benefit ignores a simpler same-budget alternative.
branch_updates.minimal_test: One recurrent model with bank-health diagnosis, noisy read/write and finite repair resources; exact oracle and a necessary/sufficient condition or strict impossibility.

rejected_additions.claim: Permutation symmetry of the ideal majority function guarantees count-only stochastic reduction of its faulty implementation.
rejected_additions.reason: The six-NAND channel distinguishes011 from101 by2gamma(1-gamma)(1-2gamma)^2. The correct physical partition retains the distinguished port, yielding12 instead of8 states with hidden health.

rejected_additions.claim: A hidden repaired/degraded bank can always be replaced by independent gates having the mean failure rate.
rejected_additions.reason: The common maintenance outcome couples later failures. The task value of the mixture differs exactly from the value computed using mean error .0048.

rejected_additions.claim: Adding triplication and maintaining its voter necessarily improves upon maintaining the original selector at the same number of service operations.
rejected_additions.reason: In the declared fixture, direct four-gate selector maintenance dominates the18-gate redundant design for every service-success probability in[0,1], certified by affine endpoints. This is not a universal architecture ordering.
